articles.summary: NANPING, China, July 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Golden Heaven Group Holdings Ltd. (" Golden Heaven " or the "Company") (Nasdaq: GDHG), an amusement park rental operator in China, today announced its unaudited financial results for the six months ended March 31, 2026 ("First Half 2026").
articles.title: Golden Heaven Group Holdings Ltd. Announces Financial Results for the First Half of Fiscal Year 2026
